name: cut
description: hard cut, the new scene replaces the old one instantly
fits: keeping energy up between beats of the same moment

name: fade
fits: time jumps, calm or sad moments

name: flash
description: white camera-flash hard cut with a flash sound
fits: a shocking reveal or impact (2-3 per Short at most)

name: wipe
description: a grid of ink dots grows over the frame and shrinks away (0.44 s)
fits: the halftone or riso look; switching to a new chapter of the story

name: whip
description: fast sideways whip pan with motion blur (0.25 s), a quiet whoosh
fits: action beats: a chase, an attack, things happening fast

name: leak
description: a warm film light-leak burn over the cut (0.5 s)
fits: the silent-film or engraving look; nostalgia, memories, 'years later'

name: halftone
description: retro print: the photo rebuilt from overprinted ink dots on cream paper, slightly off register

name: engraving
description: copperplate engraving: the photo drawn as fine sepia hatching lines on cream paper

name: riso
description: risograph print: two flat inks with grain and a slight misprint

name: miniature
description: tilt-shift: blurred top and bottom bands and rich colour make the scene look like a toy model
fits: wide or aerial shots of towns, crowds, armies, ships only

name: silent
description: 1920s silent film: sepia, vignette, flicker, grain and scratches

name: question
description: the picture dims and a big question (up to 6 words) pops up and holds
fits: a cliffhanger / open-loop moment the script answers later (1 per Short)

name: kinetic
description: a spoken 1-4 word phrase whose letters drop in one by one and squash as they land
fits: a key phrase that should hit hard (2 per Short at most)
